# Software Product

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SoftwareProduct`](gmeow-SoftwareProduct.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SoftwareProduct>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A software work as an intellectual creation — the design, functionality, and behaviour of a program, library, or application, independent of any particular source repository, release event, or concrete artifact. The product facet of the five-facet model; distinct from the project (endeavour), the codebase (content), the repository (location), and the history (events). A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) (the WEMI spine).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)
